$comment: Single source of truth for the brand. Edit this, run `rebrand.ps1`, done.
Every field is also overridable on the command line -- see rebrand.py --help.
name: AiRakhi
$comment_base_url: Where the site is ACTUALLY served from, trailing slash included.
canonical, og:url, og:image, twitter:image, sitemap and robots all point
here. Keep it pointed at the live URL: aiming these at a domain that is
parked or unwired tells Google the parking page is the real page, and
leaves every share preview without an image.
When DNS finally points airakhi.online at GitHub Pages and CNAME is back,
change this to https://www.airakhi.online/ and re-run.
$comment_analytics: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID (G-...). This is gtag.js, not Tag
Manager -- a GTM container would be GTM-... and needs a different
snippet. Set to "" to strip analytics out of the pages entirely.
